description: Hex-native eBay clone MVP at examples/ebay-clone/. Exercises the full hex stack as a scaling stress test of the agent loop. Stack: Rust + SpacetimeDB WASM (marketplace module) + axum REST backend (hex architecture) + Solid.js + Vite + Tailwind. Acceptance flow: register -> post listing -> second user places live bid -> auction closes at end_time -> winner sees won-item.

domain_conventions.currency_unit: cents (u64 integer); never floats; display layer formats as USD with two decimals
domain_conventions.timestamps: unix-millis UTC (i64); SpacetimeDB scheduler uses the same epoch; no naive local times anywhere
domain_conventions.ids: SpacetimeDB Identity for users; auto-increment u64 for listings/bids/auctions
domain_conventions.username_rules: lowercase alphanumeric and underscore, length 3-32; unique; case-insensitive comparison stores canonical lowercase
domain_conventions.password_rules: minimum 8 chars; stored as argon2id hash with random per-user salt; never stored plaintext; never logged
domain_conventions.listing_title: 3-120 chars, trimmed; no control chars; not unique
domain_conventions.starting_price_cents: u64; must be > 0 and <= 100_000_000 (one million USD)
domain_conventions.bid_increment_min_cents: 1 (any positive integer cents above current highest is valid)
domain_conventions.auction_duration: min 60_000 ms (60s); max 2_592_000_000 ms (30 days); validated server-side at create_listing
domain_conventions.image_constraints: max 5 MiB per image; allowed MIME: image/png, image/jpeg; max 8 images per listing; first image is the cover
domain_conventions.image_storage: binary blob stored by backend adapter (filesystem under examples/ebay-clone/backend/data/images/<sha256>.<ext>); STDB stores only the sha256 hash + content-type + byte size
domain_conventions.auction_close_authority: the marketplace WASM module's scheduled reducer close_auction is the sole writer of the 'closed' auction state; backend MAY trigger close_auction via STDB call but never mutates auction rows directly
domain_conventions.live_updates: frontend subscribes to STDB tables via WebSocket; no polling for bid feed; backend REST is request/response only
domain_conventions.rest_image_upload: POST /api/v1/images multipart/form-data; returns { sha256, content_type, byte_size }; auth required
domain_conventions.session_token: JWT (HS256) issued by backend on login; 24h TTL; carried in Authorization: Bearer <token>
domain_conventions.no_secondary_imports_other_adapters: ADR-enforced; adapters never import sibling adapters; only composition-root.rs wires them

specs.description: register_user reducer creates a new user when username and password are valid
specs.given: no user exists with username 'alice_42'
specs.when: register_user reducer is invoked with username='alice_42', password='hunter2pass'
specs.then: a new row appears in the users table with the canonical lowercase username, argon2id password hash, created_at = current unix-millis; reducer returns Ok

specs.description: register_user rejects duplicate username (case-insensitive)
specs.given: a user already exists with username 'alice_42'
specs.when: register_user reducer is invoked with username='ALICE_42' or 'alice_42'
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'username_taken'; no new user row is created; no partial state mutation

specs.description: register_user rejects invalid usernames
specs.given: no existing user
specs.when: register_user is invoked with username 'ab' (too short), 'has space', 'UPPER!', or a 33-char string
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'invalid_username'; users table unchanged

specs.description: backend login issues a JWT for valid credentials
specs.given: a registered user 'alice_42' with known password
specs.when: POST /api/v1/auth/login is called with that username and password
specs.then: 200 OK with body { token: '<jwt>', username: 'alice_42', expires_at: <unix-millis> }; token verifies against backend HS256 secret; expires_at is 24h from now

specs.description: login rejects wrong password
specs.given: a registered user 'alice_42'
specs.when: POST /api/v1/auth/login is called with the right username but wrong password
specs.then: 401 Unauthorized; response body has no token; argon2id comparison is constant-time; failure is logged without password material

specs.description: create_listing reducer creates a listing and its associated auction row
specs.given: authenticated seller 'alice_42'; valid inputs (title='Vintage camera', starting_price_cents=2500, duration_ms=3_600_000, image_sha256s=['abc123...'])
specs.when: create_listing reducer is invoked
specs.then: a row is inserted into listings (id, seller_identity, title, description, starting_price_cents, image_sha256s, created_at); a corresponding row is inserted into auctions (listing_id, end_time = now + duration_ms, current_highest_cents = starting_price_cents, current_highest_bidder = None, status = 'active'); close_auction is scheduled to fire at end_time

specs.description: create_listing rejects invalid title length
specs.given: authenticated seller
specs.when: create_listing is invoked with title of length 2 or length 121
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'invalid_title_length'; no listing row created; no auction row created

specs.description: create_listing rejects starting_price_cents = 0 or > 100_000_000
specs.given: authenticated seller
specs.when: create_listing is invoked with starting_price_cents = 0 or starting_price_cents = 100_000_001
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'invalid_starting_price'; no rows created

specs.description: create_listing rejects out-of-range auction duration
specs.given: authenticated seller
specs.when: create_listing is invoked with duration_ms = 59_999 or duration_ms = 2_592_000_001
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'invalid_duration'; the implicit end_time is never computed; no rows created

specs.description: image upload endpoint enforces type and size limits
specs.given: authenticated user
specs.when: POST /api/v1/images receives a 4 MiB image/png file
specs.then: 200 OK; file is hashed (sha256), persisted under data/images/<sha256>.png; response is { sha256, content_type: 'image/png', byte_size: <n> }; subsequent upload of same bytes returns the existing sha256 (idempotent)

specs.description: image upload rejects oversize or wrong-type files
specs.given: authenticated user
specs.when: POST /api/v1/images receives a 6 MiB image/png OR an image/gif of any size
specs.then: 413 Payload Too Large for the oversize case; 415 Unsupported Media Type for the wrong-MIME case; no file is written to disk; no DB row recorded

specs.description: place_bid succeeds when bid strictly exceeds current highest and auction is active
specs.given: active auction with current_highest_cents=2500; bidder 'bob_99' is not the seller; now < end_time
specs.when: place_bid reducer is invoked with amount_cents=2600
specs.then: a row is inserted into bids (auction_id, bidder_identity, amount_cents, placed_at); auctions.current_highest_cents = 2600; auctions.current_highest_bidder = bob_99's Identity; STDB subscribers receive the update within one tick

specs.description: place_bid rejects amount <= current highest
specs.given: active auction with current_highest_cents=2600
specs.when: place_bid is invoked with amount_cents=2600 or 2500
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'bid_too_low'; no bid row inserted; current_highest_cents unchanged

specs.description: place_bid rejects bids after end_time even if auction.status still reads 'active'
specs.given: auction whose end_time has passed but close_auction has not yet executed (race window)
specs.when: place_bid is invoked with a sufficient amount
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'auction_ended'; the reducer reads ctx.timestamp and compares to end_time; no bid is inserted

specs.description: place_bid rejects self-bidding (seller cannot bid on own listing)
specs.given: active auction whose listing.seller_identity == ctx.sender
specs.when: place_bid is invoked
specs.then: reducer aborts with error 'self_bid_forbidden'; no bid inserted; current_highest unchanged

specs.description: close_auction scheduled reducer transitions auction to 'closed' at end_time
specs.given: active auction with end_time = T; current_highest_bidder = Some(bob_99); scheduler fires close_auction at T
specs.when: close_auction reducer executes
specs.then: auctions.status = 'closed'; auctions.closed_at = ctx.timestamp; auctions.winner_identity = Some(bob_99); auctions.winning_amount_cents = current_highest_cents; STDB subscribers see the transition exactly once

specs.description: close_auction with no bids closes as 'unsold'
specs.given: active auction at end_time with current_highest_bidder = None
specs.when: close_auction reducer executes
specs.then: auctions.status = 'closed'; auctions.winner_identity = None; auctions.winning_amount_cents = 0; the listing is marked unsold (a derivable flag, not a separate state machine)

specs.description: watch_listing adds and toggles watch state per user
specs.given: authenticated user 'carol'; an active listing L
specs.when: watch_listing reducer is invoked with listing_id=L (first call), then again (second call)
specs.then: first call inserts a row into watchlist (user_identity=carol, listing_id=L, added_at); second call removes that row (toggle); duplicate inserts never occur

specs.description: GET /api/v1/listings supports query, price, and active-only filters
specs.given: 5 listings: 3 active matching 'camera' in title; 1 closed matching 'camera'; 1 active not matching
specs.when: GET /api/v1/listings?q=camera&active=true&max_price_cents=10000
specs.then: response is a JSON array of the 3 active matching listings whose starting_price_cents <= 10000; sorted by end_time ascending (soonest first); pagination via ?limit=20&offset=0; closed listings are excluded

specs.description: frontend listing-detail page subscribes to live bid feed via STDB WebSocket
specs.given: user is viewing /listing/:id with an active auction
specs.when: another user places a bid via place_bid
specs.then: the open detail page updates current_highest_cents, highest_bidder username, and prepends the new bid to the bid history list within 1s of the reducer commit; no manual refresh required; the countdown timer ticks down each second from end_time - now

specs.description: End-to-end happy path: register, list, bid, close, win
specs.given: a fresh STDB instance + backend + frontend started via start.sh
specs.when: User A registers and logs in via the UI; A posts a listing 'Vintage camera' with starting_price=2500 cents and duration=120s; User B registers, logs in, opens the listing, and places a bid of 3000 cents; both clients wait for the countdown to hit 0
specs.then: B's bid is visible to A in under 1s; at end_time the auction transitions to 'closed' with winner=B and winning_amount=3000; B's My Won Items page shows the listing; A's My Listings page shows the listing as sold to B

specs.description: start.sh brings up STDB + backend + frontend and exits cleanly on Ctrl-C
specs.given: checkout of examples/ebay-clone/ with prerequisites installed (rust, spacetime, bun or node)
specs.when: user runs ./start.sh from examples/ebay-clone/
specs.then: script starts SpacetimeDB and publishes the marketplace module, starts the axum backend on localhost:8080, starts Vite dev server on localhost:5173, prints all three URLs, and blocks; on SIGINT (Ctrl-C) all three child processes are signalled and reaped within 5s, leaving no orphan processes and no stale port bindings

specs.description: Hexagonal boundary rules are respected throughout the backend crate
specs.given: the examples/ebay-clone/backend/ Rust crate
specs.when: `hex analyze .` is executed against the crate
specs.then: report shows: domain/ imports only domain/; ports/ imports only domain/; usecases/ imports only domain/+ports/; adapters/primary/ and adapters/secondary/ import only ports/; no sibling-adapter imports; composition-root.rs is the only file importing concrete adapters; zero boundary violations

specs.description: Secrets and credentials are never committed or logged
specs.given: the backend crate and frontend app
specs.when: the repo is grepped for typical secret patterns and the backend is exercised through the acceptance flow with TRACE-level logging
specs.then: no .env file is committed; an .env.example is present documenting required vars (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, STDB_URI); password material never appears in logs (passwords are zeroized after argon2 verify); JWT_SECRET is read only in composition-root.rs from env

specs.description: All currency math is integer cents end-to-end
specs.given: the full stack
specs.when: any code path touching prices is inspected (WASM module, backend, frontend types)
specs.then: no f32/f64 appears in any price/bid field; serialization across WASM <-> backend <-> frontend uses u64 cents; the frontend formats display values (e.g. '$25.00') only at the render boundary; round-trip of any amount preserves exact integer value

open_questions: Authentication coupling: register_user runs inside the WASM module under the user's STDB Identity, but the backend also issues JWTs for REST endpoints. Confirm with planner whether the JWT and the STDB Identity bind together (e.g. JWT carries the Identity hex) and how the frontend authenticates to STDB directly vs. via the backend.

Image storage location: spec assumes filesystem under examples/ebay-clone/backend/data/images/; confirm this matches the secondary-adapter port the planner intends (could also be S3-compatible blob store behind the same ImageStorePort).
Auction cancellation: not in scope for MVP per the task description. Confirm sellers cannot cancel an active auction once bids are placed; if they can, a separate spec is needed.
Bid retraction: assumed not allowed (eBay-style). Not specced.
Pagination defaults for /api/v1/listings: assumed limit=20, max=100. Confirm with planner.

Time source authority: spec assumes ctx.timestamp from the WASM reducer is the canonical 'now' for all auction-related decisions, and the backend defers to STDB for any time-sensitive check. Confirm no backend uses its own clock for auction-close logic.
Currency: USD assumed implicitly. No multi-currency support in MVP.
